data.rationale: The proposal matches the overall procedure and order (OpenTable, then Allrecipes, then Notes, with the same note template), but it leaves out the 4+ star filter for the recipe, the "don't click time slot/Reserve" constraint, and the "New note" click. It also lists the derived values "restaurant" and "recipe name" as parameters and gives no separate "area" parameter, since area is folded into the OpenTable query, which makes the note's area and the parameter set ambiguous.
